sources.name: Employer career sites / university hiring pages
sources.verification_level: Official Google Careers search/help and Google JobPosting documentation inspected; employer-specific parser and alerts remain prospective.

observations.scope: All target roles and levels; use each employer's US locations and student/graduate programs.
observations.api: No universal API. Prefer documented ATS adapters when identified; otherwise employer public pages and visible JobPosting JSON-LD.
observations.company_discovery: Required: employer domain -> verified careers URL -> ATS tenant/site/board. Preserve the domain-to-board evidence.
observations.freshness: Use source datePosted, validThrough and visible deadline if provided, plus first_seen_at/last_seen_at/content fingerprint. Schema dates are publisher assertions and may be missing.
observations.account_and_cost: Public reading generally does not need an account; applications/alerts vary by employer. No paid access verified.
observations.lineage: Canonical destination for aggregated/cross-posted opportunities. Preserve requisition ID and all location variants.

sources.name: Greenhouse Job Board API
sources.verification_level: Official documentation read and public greenhouse example JSON retrieved through web tool. Production adapter not tested.

observations.scope: Employer-defined, global and all levels; US/role/level filters are downstream.
observations.api: GET https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{board_token}/jobs?content=true; GET /jobs/{job_id}. GET endpoints need no authentication.
observations.company_discovery: Required board_token; no global employer discovery/search endpoint documented here.
observations.pagination: List jobs returns all board posts and meta.total; no list pagination parameters documented.
observations.freshness: List: updated_at. Detail: first_published, updated_at, application_deadline when present. updated_at is not a new-posting date.
observations.account_and_cost: No authentication for job GET; do not confuse with authenticated Harvest API or application POST.
observations.lineage: Primary published employer postings. Distinguish post id from internal_job_id; multiple posts can represent the same internal job.

sources.name: Lever Postings API
sources.verification_level: Official API README and public leverdemo endpoint retrieved. Demo is not evidence of current real employer openings or production integration.

observations.scope: Employer-defined global roles; published jobs only, not internal jobs.
observations.api: GET https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/{site}?mode=json&skip={n}&limit={n}; EU instance api.eu.lever.co.
observations.company_discovery: Required site name from employer careers link; no full-text cross-company search.
observations.pagination: skip/limit; filters include location, commitment, team and department.
observations.freshness: The public response field list inspected does not document createdAt or a publication date. Record first_seen_at/last_seen_at and content hash; do not invent posted_at.
observations.account_and_cost: Published postings publicly viewable; no job-reader login documented.
observations.lineage: Employer-hosted job ID, hostedUrl/applyUrl; downstream boards frequently repeat these jobs.

sources.name: Ashby public Job Postings API
sources.verification_level: Official public API search-index content verified; direct documentation fetch timed out. Actual /job-board/ashby JSON retrieved with fields. No production adapter test.

observations.scope: Employer-defined/global; employmentType includes Intern and FullTime.
observations.api: GET https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/{JOB_BOARD_NAME}; optional includeCompensation=true.
observations.company_discovery: Required jobs page name from jobs.ashbyhq.com/{name}.
observations.pagination: Public board API documentation returns jobs array; no pagination documented on this surface.
observations.freshness: publishedAt means last published, not original creation. isListed=false means direct-link only; exclude from publicly listed catalog.
observations.account_and_cost: Public lightweight posting surface; do not substitute employer-authenticated job.list API requiring jobsRead.
observations.lineage: Primary employer posting id/jobUrl/applyUrl; retain secondary locations and country restrictions.

sources.name: SmartRecruiters Posting API
sources.verification_level: Official API docs and external example JSON {offset:0,limit:100,totalFound:0,content:[]} retrieved. Nonempty employer response and runtime pagination still need a connector smoke test.

observations.scope: Employer-defined global openings; API supports country filtering.
observations.api: GET https://api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/{companyIdentifier}/postings; follow detail ref.
observations.company_discovery: Required companyIdentifier from employer SmartRecruiters career URL.
observations.pagination: offset/limit and totalFound; query/country/region/city/department filters documented.
observations.freshness: releasedDate appears in list object; verify employer detail/status before recommendation.
observations.account_and_cost: External public example retrieved without credentials. Current overview also describes API key/OAuth for internal postings; never mix internal/customer access into public collection.
observations.lineage: Primary employer ATS. Store posting UUID/id and company identifier.

sources.name: Workday-hosted external career sites
sources.verification_level: Official external career-site and alert capability documentation. No employer account or job feed connected.

observations.scope: Enterprise employers; important internship/graduate and infrastructure coverage, global.
observations.api: No candidate-facing unauthenticated supported job-search API verified. Public SOAP documentation is not public access to tenant data. Do not rely on reverse-engineered /wday/cxs endpoints.
observations.company_discovery: Required employer/tenant/external career site; one employer may expose multiple regional sites.
observations.pagination: Public UI-specific; not standardized by this audit.
observations.freshness: Visible posted date/deadline and public structured data when present; alerts depend on employer configuration.
observations.account_and_cost: Public search may be open; candidates create an employer account for some actions. Workday officially supports external job alerts if enabled.
observations.lineage: Primary employer jobs, often syndicated to LinkedIn/Indeed and repeated across regional sites.

sources.name: iCIMS employer job portals
sources.verification_level: Official API documentation inspected. Public portal automation and email capability per employer remain prospective.

observations.scope: Enterprise and midmarket employers; tech roles across industries, global.
observations.api: Official Job Portal API exists at api.icims.com/customers/{customerId}/..., but its examples require Basic Authorization. No global anonymous reader feed verified.
observations.company_discovery: Required employer customer/portal; use public employer portal URL, not guessed credentials.
observations.pagination: API pagination not relevant without authorized employer access; public UI-specific.
observations.freshness: Authenticated API documents updatedDate and job.jobpost.postdate filter. Public page dates depend on portal.
observations.account_and_cost: Public job pages may be readable; candidate alerts/account depend on employer. No job-seeker API credentials assumed.
observations.lineage: Primary employer postings; corporate branding/custom URLs can obscure the ATS identity.

sources.name: LinkedIn Jobs
sources.verification_level: Official alert settings and policy inspected. User login, subscriptions and actual alerts not checked.

observations.scope: Broad US roles; use internship/entry level and role/location searches; seniority labels require description checks.
observations.api: No open job-search reader API verified. Prefer delivered alerts and user-provided links; scraping/automation is expressly restricted by LinkedIn's current help policy.
observations.pagination: Email is partial; search results not an export feed.
observations.freshness: Daily or weekly email/app alerts; posting/repost dates are LinkedIn observations, not necessarily employer original publication.
observations.account_and_cost: Member account required for saved alerts; official help permits up to 20 alerts. Premium entitlement not inspected or required by the cited alert instructions.
observations.lineage: May be employer-direct or ATS syndication; store LinkedIn ID and resolve external employer apply link.

sources.name: Jobright
sources.verification_level: Official public homepage and H1B page read; account, subscription, personalized results and actual emails remain unverified.

observations.scope: US-oriented personalized role/location/experience matching; H1B jobs discovery page exists.
observations.api: No supported public job-reader API verified.
observations.pagination: Not verified; do not assume hidden endpoints or full result export.
observations.freshness: Homepage claims early alerts and new jobs; timing/completeness not independently established. Email frequency not documented in the official material retrieved.
observations.account_and_cost: Homepage has sign-in and Try For Free. Job-seeker paid pricing and user plan not verified; employer pricing is a separate product.
observations.lineage: Discovery layer; employer/ATS destination is canonical. H1B label must not overwrite current job-specific authorization text.

sources.name: Simplify
sources.verification_level: Official homepage FAQ and dashboard email settings inspected; actual user feed and emails not checked.

observations.scope: Particularly relevant internships and entry-level/new-grad; broader software and data roles also covered.
observations.api: No supported public job-reader API verified.
observations.pagination: No complete reader export verified; daily recommendations are a subset.
observations.freshness: Official FAQ says it indexes job boards and career pages daily; page also markets hourly additions. Dashboard emails can be Daily, Weekly or Never.
observations.account_and_cost: Official FAQ says matches/autofill/tracker free; Simplify+ paid extras. Account used for personalized feed; user plan not checked.
observations.lineage: Explicitly indexes 50+ boards and employer pages; GitHub lists and Simplify website may share upstream jobs. Preserve origin links and deduplicate across channels.

sources.name: Handshake
sources.verification_level: Official search and alert docs inspected; user account/access not checked.

observations.scope: Student/new-grad internships and full-time jobs; graduation date, school year and major preferences.
observations.api: No public candidate job-reader API verified.
observations.pagination: Alert email contains at most 25 postings; full results require signed-in saved search.
observations.freshness: Daily/weekly email, app or push for saved searches; application deadlines may be supplied.
observations.account_and_cost: Account/school-specific access must be verified; no account/payment or school eligibility assumed.
observations.lineage: Employers can post campus-specific opportunities; same requisition can appear at employer ATS and other boards, but exclusive campus descriptions should be retained.

sources.name: Northeastern NUworks (Symplicity)
sources.verification_level: Official NEU policy and actual public login page inspected; no login or private content accessed.

observations.scope: Northeastern co-op and university career opportunities; select US campus/role eligibility downstream.
observations.api: No public candidate reader API or export feed verified.
observations.freshness: Employer search-cycle dates/deadlines matter. Actual alert cadence not verified.
observations.account_and_cost: Student/alumni sign-in page confirmed. Co-op searching requires relevant eligibility and advisor/resume approval per official NEU guidance; this user's eligibility not established.
observations.lineage: Potential university-specific opportunities plus duplicates of employer careers jobs. Preserve NUworks posting ID and school-only context.

observations.pagination: Web/search-specific; alerts not a complete feed.
observations.freshness: Saved search emails daily or weekly for matching new jobs.
observations.account_and_cost: Official candidate overview says job seekers use it free; saved alerts require sign-in.

rules: Use interview event time for current-process relevance. If absent, label event date unknown and show post date separately; do not substitute.
Store month/quarter as intervals. If an interval crosses a cutoff, mark boundary uncertainty; do not fabricate a day. Future parts of Q4 are not observed evidence.
Latest replies, page/footer year, SEO title year, added/reported/verified date, compilation refresh, search publication estimate and crawl date are distinct.
Resolve relative dates only with a reliable page retrieval timestamp and preserve raw string; cached pages showing yesterday can be stale.
A 2027 intern/2026 new-grad cohort can be interviewed in 2026/2025; retain both cohort and event date.
Rank exact company+US+role+level above newer mismatched geography/seniority. Exclude Canada primary job/report matching; unknown location remains unknown.
Record separate dates/permalinks for comments and follow-ups; do not turn a current comment into a fresh original post.
No fresher exact match is a valid result. State no public <=90-day US matching report verified instead of supplying a generic SEO guide as fresh evidence.

interview_evidence_rules: Classify original self-report, edited/anonymized self-report, repost/translation, multi-report compilation, editorial guide, mock/practice and promotion separately.
Deduplicate canonical URLs, crosslinks, distinctive question sequence, timeline/outcome and text similarity. Derived PracHub/InterviewDB/IQ/IGotAnOffer pages and originals share an evidence family.
One candidate story copied onto five platforms counts once; independent corroboration means distinct candidates/events with identifiable provenance, not domain count.
Use report observations for that candidate/team only. Do not infer employer-wide process, active headcount or sponsorship guarantee from a single anecdote.
Confidence should factor exact target match, event-date precision, full text vs preview, explicit firsthand status, transformations and independent agreement.
High confidence can mean confidence in what the page says; it does not establish that an anonymous claim happened. Label both source visibility and claim reliability.
Store short factual paraphrases and links, not full protected or paywalled report text. Respect public/member access boundaries.
interview_retrieval_order: Resolve exact company identity, US location, role family, hiring level/cohort and requisition from official job and recruiter material first.
Search public original candidate sources: 1P3A, LeetCode Discuss, Reddit, Glassdoor; 30 days then 90 days, exact US+role+level match.
Consult PracHub/InterviewDB, Interview Query, Hello Interview and Aced to discover reports/questions; trace to original when available and keep derived status.
Blind and Indeed add recruiting-process/team signals; require exact target match and distinguish completed experience from requests for advice.
Expand to 180 then 365 days only if needed, labeling each expansion; preparation guides/mock tools and China-heavy sources are supplemental.
A paid membership choice should follow demonstrated recent exact-match preview inventory and original-source coverage, not headline counts or testimonials.
